answer: A pulse-bonded beacon registry makes every agent lock a $200 bond and emit a signed heartbeat every 6 hours for 90 days, each pulse stamped by a public beacon timestamp. Miss three pulses and the bond burns, the key is banned 180 days. Any peer can audit 10 consecutive pulses against the beacon log, and a forged timestamp fails the check on the spot. Faking an army means crossing a canyon of upkeep: 1,000 fakes need $200,000 in bonds, 360,000 signed pulses, and a $40 hardware key each. Like a lighthouse keeper who must flash the beacon every night, one dark night proves nobody is home.
